COST: 74

This rescues the 3 adults at Kalika farm (14 driving minutes round trip). It defers the 3 adults at Dupcheshwar market and Uttargaya farm. Reaching them costs 64 minutes for Dupcheshwar and 110 for Uttargaya, which is more than the 20 and 40 minute deferral penalties.
